prompts.proposer:
Call proposer_brief() FIRST. The tool output includes pattern_analyst_insights — use trend_champion, seasonality_champion, and insights.recommended_method_hint to bias your candidate selection toward non-mean methods. MUST propose at least 3 candidates including at least 1 non-baseline type. Return ONLY JSON per instructions. IMPORTANT: you MUST ONLY reference candidate names that appear in the tool output candidate_library; unknown names will hard-stop.
PATTERN ANALYST INSIGHTS: trend_champion='rf', seasonality_champion='ONLY_CWT_rf', recommended_method='median_or_trimmed_mean'. Narrative: The true series exhibits mixed trend directions across folds (down in fold 0, up in fold 1) with moderate seasonality. Multiple models achieve perfect trend correlation (1.0), but ONLY_CWT_rf dominates in seasonality capture (0.5773) and overall RMSE (19.31). High model disagreement (RMSE spread 0.78) and unstable rankings (Kendall τ=-0.40) suggest robust median/trimmed-mean combinations over simple averaging.
